verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a UI library and its tooling: frameworks and CLIs in this ecosystem can collect usage data and offer opt-outs. However, the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out mechanism for React, its compiler, or DevTools. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
